changeSet.comment: nexus-h4w9o: nexus.partition_copy_access skips any grantee whose role has rolbypassrls when it copies the parent's ACL onto a new leaf or model partition, so nexus_diag's SELECT on nexus.chunks (re-granted every boot for the diag view) no longer lands on a tenant's leaves between boots. Everything else in the body is vectors-030-1's. No data effect: a function definition only; the rollback restores the vectors-030-1 body.
